name: Farlo
backstory: Works the docks at Terfila, has heard the Forliamus account of the tollhouse dispute retold at every tavern along the port since he was a boy.

experience.text: Had a child with Tamuken, named Farmuken.
Heard that Trezco and Forliamus now have a child, Forliazco.
Heard that Trezco and Tamuken now have a child, Tamuzco.
Had a child with Forliamus, named Forliarlo.
Heard that Tamuken and Forliazco now have a child, Forliuken.
Had a child with Forliazco, named Farliazco.
Heard that Forliazco and Farmuken now have a child, Forliamuk.
Heard that Forliarlo and Forliuken now have a child, Forliukar.
Had a child with Trezco, named Trezarlo.

criterion.standard: counts a good telling above a precise one, same as everyone else on the docks
criterion.wasted_life: spending a life retelling a story he was never part of and never checked
criterion.derivation: collision between his backstory (heard the tollhouse story retold his whole life) and crossing_toll_dispute itself
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: unloads crates at the market stalls through the morning tide, trades gossip for a cut rate on drink, tells the tollhouse story a little differently every time

needs: a traveler passing through who was actually part of the raid or the blockade
arc.premise: Farlo wants to hear the tollhouse story once from someone who was actually there, not retold a fourth time by someone who heard it from someone else - so at least one version he tells has been checked against a real source, even if he keeps embellishing the rest.
